description: Lilambd World Marketplaces Physical and Digital API. Where the world buys and sells, in one shape: 409,266 physical market places in 228 countries (199,888 shopping malls, 64,192 farmers' markets, 31,899 flea markets, 20,775 auction houses, 11,238 bazaars and souks, 5,173 night markets, 3,609 fish markets, wholesale markets, hawker centres and more) with coordinates, region, town, website and a locality class (big city, city, regional, remote: 29,146 places over 100 km from any 100k+ city), plus 5,457 digital marketplaces and app stores. Nearby search, country and region views, rankings, coverage gaps and a one-call country profile. Sources: Overture Maps places 2026-10-21.0 (CDLA-Permissive-2.0 / Apache-2.0 / CC0 rows only) and Wikidata (CC0). Compiled by Lilambd. Routes: /gaps (min_population, limit, offset); /rank (kind, by, limit, offset); /kinds; /nearby (lat*, lon*, radius_km, kind, limit, offset); /places (country, kind, locality_class, q, region, town, limit, offset); /digital (q, country, kinds, deal_type, limit, offset); /countries (sort, limit, offset); /places/{id}; /digital/{id}; /admin1/{iso2} (limit, offset); /countries/{iso2}. Paid $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /gaps, /rank, /kinds, /nearby, /places, /digital, /countries, /places/{id}, /digital/{id}, /admin1/{iso2}, /countries/{iso2}. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
